name: Hayate
source:
Rikka's friend and colleague. He is the eldest son of a merchant family. Perhaps because he has many siblings, he is cheerful, friendly, and caring. He is honest and passionate. He speaks with a foreign accent and is a skilled conversationalist who gets people involved. At worst, he is overly friendly and meddlesome.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/05blind_3.html]official website[/url]]
